A '''crown prince''' was a<ref name="Codex" /> [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="Panteer" /> [[Gender/Legends|male]] member of [[House Panteer]], the royal family of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].<ref name="Codex" /> Around [[3703 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|An Iron Fist|Alderaan}} indicates that [[House of Thul|House Thul]] was exiled sixty [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the events of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', placing their exile around [[3703 BBY]].</ref> the [[Prince/Legends|prince]] was arranged to [[Marriage/Legends|marry]] a [[Unidentified Thul child|girl]] from [[House of Organa/Legends|House Organa]], but a [[Unidentified Jedi (Thul scandal)|young Jedi]] discovered that the bride was in fact a daughter of [[House of Thul|House Thul]]&mdash;the child had been switched at birth with an [[Unidentified Organa infant|Organa infant]]. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] stopped the wedding and exposed the Thuls' treachery, resulting in their [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exile]].<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
The crown prince, whose name was never identified, was first mentioned in the House Thul Codex entry in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Codex" />
